title: A Reporter's Questions
subtitle: 考点：采访 / 日常安排 / on duty

dialogue.t: What is your daily routine, Li Hua?
I get up at six every day. I have breakfast at half past six.
What do you do at school?
We have classes in the morning and afternoon. This week I am on duty. I clean the classroom with my classmates.
I stay at school for a while to do my homework. Then I go home.

vocab: reporter 记者 · on duty 值班 · duty 值日 · routine 日常 · stay 停留 · while 一段时间

questions.why: 对话中的 Reporter 在采访。

questions.stem: When does Li Hua get up?
questions.why: I get up at six every day. half past six 是早饭时间。

questions.stem: What does Li Hua do this week?
questions.why: This week I am on duty.

questions.stem: What does Li Hua do after school?
options: He stays at school to do homework.
questions.why: I stay at school for a while to do my homework.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Li Hua has breakfast at six.
Li Hua cleans the classroom this week.
questions.why: I clean the classroom with my classmates.

questions.stem: Li Hua goes home before doing homework.
questions.why: 他先在学校做作业，再回家。

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: I ____ at school for a while.
